title: Re-importing a fully different old number creates a separate part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with Min 1, Max 5 and 3 in bin location A, then rename it to a fully different number, so its old number matches no part any more.
  • Have a parts import file with one row whose part number is part A's old number, with Min 4, Max 10, quantity 2 and bin location A.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (Settings, then Data Import, then Inventory).
custom_steps:
1. Upload the file.
  2. Run the import.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's old number in the Search box.
  6. Replace the search text with part A's new number.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's old number in the Search box.
  9. Replace the search text with part A's new number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • A new part is listed under the old number, with Min 4 and Max 10 and 2 in bin location A.

Step 6:

  • Renamed part A is untouched under its new number, still with Min 1 and Max 5.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • One entry is listed for the old number.

Step 9:

  • One entry is listed for the new number: two entries in all (1 + 1 = 2).
